questions.qtext: Hunting phenomenon in synchronous machine can be avoided by following way(s). Select the correct option(s).

options.text: by operating machine at rated load.
by designing synchronous machine with suitable synchronizing power coefficient.

questions.solution:
(a, c, d)
The undesirable phenomenon of hunting, can be guarded against in three ways:
• By using a flywheel
• By designing synchronizing machine with suitable synchronizing power coefficient.
• By the employment of damper winding.
